items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I've had reports from Steely Dan, because of course, I haven't talked to Chick recently. But I took it upon myself to kind of help to do something for the future... I'm now in the throes of making arrangements to buy for my very own a -- now I have to think of the name of the instrument... capped by

ctx.x: And Chick Corea particularly, writing a piece, a very serious piece by your standards and mine, a piece that runs about 18 to 20 minutes, and it's in three complete movements, three parts. And I think it's a complete work of art for this particular age we're living in.
Uh-huh. This "Suite for a Hot Band," by Chick Corea, you're talking about.
